│             │ │ int:\n    overall_sum = sum(arr)\n             │
│             │ │ accumulator, split_index = 0, 0\n    for value │
│             │ │ in arr[:-1]:  # Creates slice on every call!\n │
│             │ │ accumulator += value\n        split_index +=   │
│             │ │ 1\n        if accumulator >= overall_sum // 2: │

│             │ │ return                                         │
│             │ │ split_index\n```\n\n**After:**\n```python\ndef │
│             │ │ _split_array_by_half_sum(arr: Sequence) ->     │
│             │ │ int:\n    overall_sum = sum(arr)\n    half_sum │
│             │ │ = overall_sum // 2  # Pre-compute once\n    \n │
│             │ │ # Edge case: single element or empty\n    if   │
│             │ │ len(arr) <= 1:\n        return 0\n    \n       │
│             │ │ accumulator = 0\n    # Iterate through all but │
│             │ │ the last element without creating a slice\n    │

│             │ │ half_sum:\n            return i + 1\n    \n    │
│             │ │ # If we never reached half sum, return the     │
│             │ │ last valid index\n    return len(arr) -        │
│             │ │ 1\n```\n\n### 2. Test Coverage\n**File:**      │

│             │ │ Function\n\n**Location:**                      │
│             │ │ `python/sglang/srt/two_batch_overlap.py:41-57… │
│             │ │ Identified:**\n- The function created an       │
│             │ │ unnecessary slice `arr[:-1]` on every call\n-  │
│             │ │ This caused memory allocation overhead and     │
│             │ │ cache inefficiency\n- The division             │
│             │ │ `overall_sum // 2` was repeated in every loop  │
│             │ │ iteration\n- No early exit for edge            │
│             │ │ cases\n\n**Solution                            │
│             │ │ Implemented:**\n```python\ndef                 │
│             │ │ _split_array_by_half_sum(arr: Sequence) ->     │
│             │ │ int:\n    overall_sum = sum(arr)\n    half_sum │
│             │ │ = overall_sum // 2  # Pre-compute once\n    \n │
│             │ │ # Edge case: single element or empty\n    if   │
│             │ │ len(arr) <= 1:\n        return 0\n    \n       │
│             │ │ accumulator = 0\n    # Iterate through all but │
│             │ │ the last element without creating a slice\n    │
│             │ │ for i in range(len(arr) - 1):\n                │
│             │ │ accumulator += arr\n        if accumulator >=  │
│             │ │ half_sum:\n            return i + 1\n    \n    │
│             │ │ # If we never reached half sum, return the     │
│             │ │ last valid index\n    return len(arr) -        │
│             │ │ 1\n```\n\n**Key Optimizations:**\n1. ✅        │
│             │ │ Eliminated `arr[:-1]` slice creation\n2. ✅    │
│             │ │ Pre-computed `half_sum` to avoid repeated      │
│             │ │ division\n3. ✅ Added early exit for edge      │
│             │ │ cases (len <= 1)\n4. ✅ Improved code clarity  │
│             │ │ with explicit comments\n5. ✅ Better cache     │
│             │ │ locality without temporary slice\n\n### 2.     │
